title: SinCos Embedded Optimized
text: Implement sine and cosine functions, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Theta units} sets Unit of θ e; {Optimize for selected embedded target hardware} sets the optimize block for selected hardware, {Approximation method}, {Number of data points for lookup table} sets the size of lookup table array, {Table data type} sets the data type of lookup table array, {Number of iterations} and {Theta data type} sets the data type of lookup table array fixdt. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Optimize for selected embedded target hardware
params.values: Optimize block for selected hardware off (default) | on

params.name: Approximation method
params.values: Approximation method for computing sine and cosine signals Lookup (default) | None | CORDIC | TI IQMATH

params.name: Theta units
params.values: Unit of θ e Per-unit (default) | Radians | Degrees

params.name: Number of data points for lookup table
params.values: Size of lookup table array 1024 (default) | scalar

params.name: Table data type
params.values: Data type of lookup table array Inherit: Inherit via input (default) | double | single | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Number of iterations for CORDIC algorithm 11 (default) | positive integer, less than or equal to word length of fixed-point input

params.name: Theta data type
params.values: Data type of lookup table array fixdt([],16,0) (default) | double | single |
